first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A boxy taxi with a red lower body and beige roof, featuring a white roof light, dark rear window, and yellow rear license plate.

entities.name: longitudinal main road
entities.identification: The multilane road surface extending into the distance from the center of the frame, with white markings and yellow crosswalk stripes visible in the farther section.

entities.name: line of roadside vehicles on the right
entities.identification: The collection of background vehicles lined up along the curb on the right, including light-colored and red vehicles, excluding Vehicle A, Vehicle C, and Vehicle E.

entities.name: group of hanging signs
entities.identification: The collection of rectangular signs extending from the roadside over the road, including signs with cyan text on a red background, orange text on a blue-green background, and yellow text on a black background.

entities.name: building facades along the street
entities.identification: The storefronts, walls, and projecting structures on both sides of the road, with a larger pinkish-brown wall and dark structure nearby at the right edge.

entities.name: illuminated signs along the street
entities.identification: The collection of illuminated signs near the storefronts along the street, including a white horizontal lightbox and a cyan-green illuminated sign.

entities.name: group of pedestrians on the left sidewalk
entities.identification: The collection of background pedestrians on the left sidewalk and near the storefronts at the intersection, including people in dark blue, light-colored, and yellow clothing, excluding Person B.

entities.name: roadside sidewalk
entities.identification: The long, narrow pedestrian pavement on the left side of the longitudinal main road, widening and turning around the distant street corner, with parts illuminated by cyan-white light.

entities.name: roadside metal guardrail
entities.identification: The low railing of thin bars along the traffic-lane edge of the sidewalk at the upper-left intersection, with vertical bars and horizontal connecting bars.

entities.name: Vehicle C
entities.identification: The blue-gray sedan at the lower-left edge, featuring a warm yellow reflection on its roof, a dark rear window, a yellow rear license plate, and curved taillights.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The single person beside the curb on the left, wearing a dark top with a light-colored patch on the chest, light-colored trousers, and dark shoes.

entities.name: Vehicle E
entities.identification: The silver-white, tall-bodied van in the distance with its rear facing the camera, featuring a dark rectangular rear window, a yellow rear license plate, and vertical taillights on both sides.

entities.name: traffic light at the intersection
entities.identification: The dark signal device on the vertical pole at the upper-left intersection, with a cyan-green upward arrow illuminated in frame 15.
